newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev falls to all-time low vs dlr at close.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev falls to all-time low vs dlr at close.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at an all-time low of 260.00/50 per dollar, down from 258-260 in the morning due a rise in foreign currency demand from commercial banks amid low supply to the interbank market, dealers said.

"The currency lost around three levs from the previous close because several banks sought dollars to square positions after a fuel importer bought large foreign currency volumes on Tuesday," a bank dealer said.
The lev closed at 257.00/50 per dollar on Tuesday.

Dollar supply from commercial banks was much lower than demand and the central bank sold small dollar volumes between 258 levs in the morning and 259.50 in the afternoon in a bid to prop up the lev, traders said.

The previous record low of 256-258 levs per dollar was recorded at the end of September just before the central bank raised its main interest rate to 300 percent annually from 108 percent. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
